dataset.description:
The software uses public data dumps from DOAJ and OpenCitations. 
The python script uses libraries such as Request, Pandas, Tarfile and plotly for gathering, manipulating, analyzing and visualizing data of this research.
dataset.title: Software for coverage of open citations in DOAJ journals

dataset.description:
The dataset contains the results for our research on the coverage of open citations in DOAJ journals. More specifically, JSON and CSV files depending on the kind of data and operations at each step. 
They will contain: 
  • Journals and metadata about it (ISSN, EISSN)
  • Citations count for each journal (made by)
  • Citations count for each journal (made to)
  • Open citations count for each journal (made by)
  • Open citations count for each journal (made to)
  • Open citations grouped by year
dataset.title: Dataset for the coverage of open citations in DOAJ journals

dmp.description: The purpose of this research is finding out the coverage of DOAJ articles in terms of citations, according to OpenCitations indexes: how many citations DOAJ journals receive and do; how many of these involve open access articles; and finally, the presence of trends over time of the availability of citations involving these articles.
dmp.title: Coverage of open citations in DOAJ journals
